name: ContentSwitcher

props.name: light
props.description: `true` to use the light version. been deprecated in favor of the new `Layer` component. It will be removed in the next major release.

props.name: lowContrast
props.description: `true` to use the low contrast version.

props.name: selectedIndex
props.description: Specify a selected index for the initially selected content

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Choose whether or not to automatically change selection on focus when left/right arrow pressed. Defaults to 'automatic'

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the Content Switcher. Currently supports either `sm`, `md` (default) or `lg` as an option.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon ContentSwitcher rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
